comment.body:
It's good to get a snapshot of how far this dipshittery has progressed.

I don't just mean weaponizing the charge of anti-Semitism against any and all criticism of anything any Jew, anywhere, says or does -- which, of course, is taking the whole shitshow to ludicrous extremes.

I'm talking about the very definition that says anti-Semitism means anti-Jew.

Palestinians are Semites.

Syrians are Semites.

Jordanians are Semites.

Lebanese are Semites.

Iraqis are Semites.

Maybe I left some out?

So, the bullshit of equating anti-Semitic with anti-Jew is rooted in the narcissistic supremacism which ignores all Semitic peoples other than Jews, and elevates Jews as if only they are Semitic.

So, right off the bat, it's obvious we're dealing with a kind of ethnic psychosis.

And then there's the age-old, vanilla narcissism involved in reacting to any and all criticism, challenge, objection, or opposition to what you do and say as if questioning you and your actions is a sin that could never be justified.

Offendable unquestionability is a hallmark characteristic of every cult leader and cult member.

Only narcissists interpret every question, criticism, challenge, objection, or opposition as a personal attack.

People who play the anti-Semitic card are not honest people. They're not strong or powerful people. They do not stand on the side of truth.

This is obvious, because no honest, strong, powerful person standing on the side of truth gets offended when you merely question them, or criticize them, or challenge or object or oppose what they've said or done, as if you were personally attacking them when all you've done is disagree with them.

These are not well people. Or they're straight up, shit-faced liars. Those aren't well people, either.

At this point, "anti-Semitism" is right up there with "conspiracy theory" and "misinformation" -- all of them bullshit; all of them used by people operating on a fourth- or fifth-grade intelligence level (is that an insult to 4th+ or 5th-graders?); all of them gimmicks used by people who not only don't love truth, but actively work to confuse, obscure, and pervert truth.

This entire anti-Semitic thing is pigshit. No other ethnic or religious group gets their very own special protections coded into law, sanctified by dogma and public opinion. It's straight up discrimination. And it constitutes hatred and hate speech towards every single person in every single group of every single faith unless they recognize Jews as the only Semites, agree with and support Jews -- let alone, as the guy in the video makes clear are quite distinct from Jews, agree with and support Zionists.

The whole shitshow is absurd, irrational, stupid. In that it is invariably used to vindicate evildoing on the part of Jews, Zionists, or psychotic Israelis -- IT IS EVIL.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i1b7J7pzgNo

comment.body:
This is called codependence. It's essential to cult formation. It doesn't guarantee that a person will join a cult, but it does guarantee that they will think like a cult member. 

Codependence is precipitated by a primal kind of dehumanization in which we lose confidence in our own capabilities, especially our judgment. This puts us into a state of existential need for parental proxy figures to think for us, to make judgments and come to conclusions for us, and even to do for us what we have excluded ourselves from doing.
